g.text: KALAKAR SETU
HOW THE APP WORKS • SIMPLE FLOWCHART
SIH 2025
Ministry of Tribal Affairs
01. Open App & Start
Click [ 🎧 शुरू करें / Start ] to hear voice guide
02. Login with Mobile Number
Type phone number & get 6-digit SMS code [🔊 Audio Guide]
Choose: [ 🎨 Maker / Artisan ] • [ 🛍️ Buyer ] • [ 🤝 Helper ]
🎨 ARTISAN / MAKER (कारीगर)
03. Artisan Home Screen
See new orders waiting to be made
See your total earnings & safe bank balance (₹)
04. Take Photo of Craft
Camera guides you with a simple on-screen frame
Take front and close-up pictures easily
05. Clean Background (AI)
Phone automatically removes messy room background
Makes it look like a clean studio shop photo
06. Speak in Your Mother Tongue
Speak in Hindi or your own local language
Tell how many hours it took and what materials used
App writes title & description in English and Hindi
07. Fair Price Calculator
Adds cost of clay/cloth + hours of hard work
You get full ₹95 out of every ₹100 earned
08. Original Craft Badge (GI Tag)
Gives government badge proving it is 100% genuine
Shows your name and village as the true maker
09. Publish to Store in 1 Tap
Your craft is now visible to buyers all over India
Ready to receive orders and get paid
🛍️ BUYER / CUSTOMER (खरीदार)
03. Browse Indian Crafts
Discover handmade pottery, sarees & wood crafts
Find festive gift boxes and special village items
04. See Details & Hear Story
Zoom into high-quality clear pictures
Tap [ 🔊 Listen ] to hear the artisan tell their story
05. Check Original Stamp
Check government GI badge (No fake plastic copies)
See artisan photo, state and village name
06. Shopping Cart & Fair Bill
Choose quantity and colors
Clear bill: ₹95 of ₹100 goes straight to the maker
No secret middlemen commissions
07. Enter Home Address
Delivers to any pincode across India via India Post
Option for company GST bill if buying in bulk
08. Pay Safely (Money Locked)
Pay using Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm or Card
Money stays 100% safe until parcel arrives in hand
09. Track Parcel to Your Door
See: Packed ➔ Dispatched ➔ On the Way ➔ Delivered
Real-time India Post SpeedPost tracking
🤝 VILLAGE HELPER (सहयोगी)
03. Village Work Monitor
See total crafts being made across the village
Make sure orders are finished on time
04. Help Elderly Artisans
Help older weavers and potters use the app
Link their bank account and take their voice story
05. Share Big Orders
Divide a big 1,000-piece order among 15 families
No single artisan is overworked; everyone earns
06. Advance Raw Materials
Provide clay, thread or wood before work begins
Artisans don't need to take expensive loans
Settled cleanly once customer pays
07. Quality & Packing Check
Check that size, paint and finish are perfect
Pack safely in strong boxes so nothing breaks
08. Share Work if Someone is Sick
If an artisan falls ill or rain stops work
1-Tap transfer pending items to a nearby neighbour
09. Handover to India Post
Give all packed boxes to postman together
Scan postal barcode to start live tracking
KALAKAR SETU • SAFE PAYMENT & DELIVERY SYSTEM
Customer gets genuine handmade crafts • Maker gets paid fairly without middlemen
1. Instant Money to Maker (₹95%)
Customer receives parcel & enters OTP
Money sends directly to artisan's bank in 5 sec
No waiting for months to get paid
2. Real Handmade Certificate
Buyer gets a digital certificate with QR code
Scan to see the maker's photo, village & video
100% proof that it's genuine craft
3. Good Reviews & Bank Loans
Buyer leaves 5-star review and tips the artisan
Village helper receives small 3% support fee
Artisan builds credit to get easy bank loans
KALAKAR SETU • Easy App Flowchart • Explained in Simple Everyday Language
